admission.justification: The members together promise that an agent's shell cannot reach the developer's live host through the helper: the environment member removes the selectors, the comparison member refuses another host, and the admitted member bounds the only state with none; no member promises that alone.

guarantee: No request the sandbox tool-call helper runs addresses a Paseo runtime other than the sandbox's own, and its one admitted no-host state reaches no home or address at all.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_pnt_sandbox.py::test_a_resolved_host_outside_the_sandbox_is_refused_before_any_call, ::test_a_sandbox_whose_settings_select_another_host_is_refused, ::test_a_request_port_that_is_not_a_sandbox_port_is_refused; the two real refusals in the freeze report §Rule 6

title: The sandbox tool-call helper's host admission
